##### Project general facts

Ellington Beach House is a refined waterfront development located on the tranquil East Crescent of Palm Jumeirah. Designed as an exclusive lifestyle destination, it reflects the elegance of a private members’ club, offering a sophisticated coastal living experience. Its superyacht-inspired architecture is carefully oriented to maximize panoramic views, capturing both sunrise over the Arabian Gulf and sunset over Dubai’s skyline, while blending seamlessly with its prestigious beachfront setting.

The development offers a curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellbeing, relaxation, and sustainable living. Residents can enjoy thoughtfully designed fitness facilities, eco-conscious communal spaces, and wellness-focused environments that promote a balanced lifestyle. The project also incorporates environmentally responsible features such as energy-efficient systems, water-saving solutions, EV charging stations, and sustainable building materials, ensuring a modern and conscious approach to luxury living.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials and a refined design approach that emphasizes comfort, functionality, and elegance. The kitchens are thoughtfully designed with premium materials and smart layouts, combining practicality with a seamless culinary experience. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their own lifestyle and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah is a luxurious community located on an artificial island that is shaped like a palm tree, with a trunk, fronds, and a crescent-shaped breakwater that surrounds the island.

The community is home to a variety of high-end residential properties, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, as well as some of the most luxurious hotels and resorts in Dubai. The community is known for its stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, its pristine beaches, and its world-class amenities.

In addition to residential properties and hotels, Palm Jumeirah is home to a range of retail and dining options, including the iconic Atlantis, The Palm resort, which features an array of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues. The island also boasts a range of recreational activities, including water sports, beach clubs, and golf courses.
